FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DayCare.en:
Oh? A POKéMON EGG?
…I have no idea.\p…Oh, wait. The DAY-CARE people
in town were saying something.\pThey said that they'd found EGGS
before on their property.
FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DayCare.fr:
Oh ? Un ŒUF POKéMON ? … Aucune
idée.\pOh, attends, il me semble que les
gens de la PENSION en parlaient.\pIls disaient en avoir déjà eu chez
eux.

FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NewPoke.en: What's this?\pThe new POKéMON JOURNAL hasn't\narrived on this island?
FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NewPoke.fr: Quoi ?\pLe nouveau JOURNAL POKéMON n'est\npas encore arrivé sur l'île ?

FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RareIce.en: There's a rare kind of ICE POKéMON\nthat lives in the cave.\pWe get a lot of visitors hoping to\nsee that POKéMON.
FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RareIce.fr: Il y a un POKéMON GLACE très rare\nqui vit dans cette grotte.\pY'a plein de monde qui vient ici en\nespérant le voir.

Text_BodySlamTeach.en:
Ready?
Boing!\pWe're having a BODY SLAM match
to see who wimps out first.\pIf you were to join us, you'd be
squashed like a bug, though…\pHow about I teach BODY SLAM to
a POKéMON of yours instead?
Text_BodySlamTeach.fr: Prêts ? Go !\pOn fait un concours de PLAQUAGE.\pSi tu veux essayer, tu vas te faire\nécraser comme un insecte !\pEt si j'apprenais plutôt cette\ncapacité à un de tes POKéMON ?

Text_BodySlamWhichMon.en: Which POKéMON wants to learn how\nto BODY SLAM?
